name: io.github.chrischall/juggle-mcp
description: Juggle (whyjuggle.com) babysitting/petsitting for families: sits, sitters, messages (AI-built).

environmentVariables.name: JUGGLE_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: The email address you sign in to whyjuggle.com with (a family account). Needed by every tool except juggle_list_locations; the server starts without it.

environmentVariables.name: JUGGLE_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Your whyjuggle.com password. Google/Facebook-only sign-ins are not supported. Needed by every tool except juggle_list_locations; the server starts without it.

environmentVariables.name: JUGGLE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Site origin override, for tests or a local stub only. Defaults to https://whyjuggle.com; must be https (loopback http allowed).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CONFIRM_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Confirm-gated writes on clients without prompts: ask-user (default), auto, or refuse.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CONFIRM_ELICITATION
environmentVariables.description: Set to off to skip the confirmation prompt even on clients that declare elicitation support.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CONFIRM_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: How long a write's confirmToken stays valid, in seconds (default 600).
